name: "Memory" and "Dream"
descriptionTemplate: Hand size limit +2, draw +2 cards. "Clear Memory" starts at 5 stacks, playing marked cards changes the "Clear Memory". When "Clear Memory" is below 5, each reduction by 1 increases Final DMG by 10%, reduces Shield and HP recovery by 5%; when above 5, every stack increases Shield and HP Recovery by 5%, reduces Final DMG by 10%.
lore:
"Come, listen to me."
"Let me transform your memories and dreams."
"Into an incredibly delicious dessert."
